scope: Read-only review of SDK route, VBR writes, loan failure propagation, and existing phase trace. No runtime edits, priority changes, or pin updates.

console_reports.evolution1_new_x: Black screen after MPEG Sofdec on af9e01c8a271, reported by user.
console_reports.evolution2_new_x: Behaves as expected, reported by user.
console_reports.baseline_limit: af401 New X Evolution1 was not console-proven; the prior successful Evolution1 VMU observation used Standard. Do not label this a proven regression from af401.

exact_owner_route.finding: Exact supplied Evolution1 retains the unchanged exact-owner admission path; structural discover is called only if exact admit returns zero. Exact Evolution1 does not take fallback.
exact_owner_route.readiness: At admitted VBR 0x8c00f400 the dynamic readiness checks preserve original behavior plus canonical/alignment bounds: cookie, actual VBR equals retained owner, and both SCI slots equal callback.

loan_contract_delta.new_predicate: actual VBR != retained vector600[14] faults begin/end.
loan_contract_delta.old_predicate: actual VBR == private raw replacement VBR faults begin/end; SDK route does not install that raw VBR.
loan_contract_delta.fault_latches: src/loader/retail_async.c:765: QUARANTINED loan, card.ready false, reader IO failure, hook_fault=1.
loan_contract_delta.status: A real source-level behavior change, but no evidence Evolution1 changes VBR around this transition. Do not remove the guard on this hypothesis alone.

host_comparison.method: Real retail_async/sci_stream/card model, completed read, stopped receiver, IMASK15; compile structural flag zero versus one with ASan/UBSan.
host_comparison.interpretation: Demonstrates the dependency, not a console cause or legitimacy of a foreign current VBR. Equality by itself is not retained-owner validity (matching zero values also pass this loan-only check).

original_evolution1_vbr_scan.other_ldc_l_hits: 0x8c09270e and 0x8c09ba2a occur in floating literal data.
original_evolution1_vbr_scan.limits: Static original-image opcode/data classification; not whole-program reachability proof. BIOS routines, dynamic code and corrupted saved frames are not excluded.

expected_fault_report.finding: Ordinary worker storage loan FAULT marks durable_card.faulted; completion calls fail(24), which restores display and reports. No authored silent continuation follows a normally completed failure. A plain black screen therefore does not establish this guard as the cause.
expected_fault_report.low_failure: src/loader/vmu_native_background_resident.c:179: valid worker terminal reports; invalid terminal still restores the saved display and halts.

existing_evolution_trace.purpose: Locate phase/checkpoint progression without changing approved reader policy.
existing_evolution_trace.actual_vbr: Page5 SAVED EXCEPTION SPC SSR VBR EVENT, sampled at last checkpoint.
existing_evolution_trace.freshness_limit: The last code0x23 checkpoint precedes the overlay/storage loan; an end-loan failure can display an earlier VBR.
existing_evolution_trace.mode_exclusion: Mode6 phase trace differs from mode2 profiling; profile-only read-ahead failure/timeline pages are not included.
existing_evolution_trace.recommendation: Expose already compiled mode6 through the dual installer first. Retain current runtime guards and SCI priority1 until actual evidence identifies the failing phase.

cache_handoff: src/loader/native_readahead_aux.c is byte-for-byte unchanged af401 to af9e. Approved PIO-pair and prior cache handoff fix remain present.
remaining_proof_gap: Cold source/ABI tests do not execute post-Sofdec title flow or establish long-term SDK callback ownership. No hardware cause verified.
